Profiles.description: Alternative to a single profile, allows for multiple tenants

Domain.description: The value in Primary domain in the Azure Active Directory Overview

Instance.description: The Azure Active Directory instance, e.g. "https://login.microsoftonline.com".

TenantId.description: The value in Directory (tenant) ID on the app registration Overview

ClientId.description: The value in Application (Client) ID on the app registration Overview

ManagedIdentityClientId.description: Optional user-assigned managed identity client ID to use when CredentialType is ManagedIdentity. Leave empty for system-assigned managed identity.

ClientSecret.description: The client secret created for the app registration. Only required when CredentialType is Secret.

CertificateThumbprint.description: The thumbprint of a certificate in the certificate store to use when CredentialType is Certificate.

CertificateStorePath.description: The certificate store to load the certificate from when CredentialType is Certificate, in "StoreLocation/StoreName" format. Defaults to "CurrentUser/My".

CredentialType.description: How the application authenticates to Entra ID (defaults to Secret)

CallbackPath.description: The request path within the application's base path where the user-agent will be returned.

SignedOutCallbackPath.description: The uri where the user agent will be redirected to after application is signed out from the identity provider.

DisplayName.description: The display name for use on the login button

DenyLocalLogin.description: Allow users to login via Umbraco's standard login

AutoRedirectLoginToExternalProvider.description: Automatically redirect to the external login provider

SetGroupsOnLogin.description: The bindings for AD group to Umbraco group.

SetProfileImageOnLogin.description: Fetch the user's Entra ID profile photo on each login and set it as their Umbraco avatar.

Icon.description: The icon to use on the login button

ButtonStyle.description: The style to use on the login button

GroupBindings.description: The bindings for AD group to Umbraco group

DefaultGroups.description: The groups to assign to users regardless of any AD groups assigned (defaults to none)

TokenCacheType.description: The token cache type to use

DisableComposer.description: Disable the Umbraco composer, AddMicrosoftAccountAuthentication will need to be called from Program.cs

LogUnmappedRolesAsWarning.description: Log a warning if a user is assigned a role that is not mapped to an Umbraco group

TokenCacheType.description: Represents the type of token cache to use

CredentialType.description: How the application authenticates to Entra ID. Secret uses ClientSecret. ManagedIdentity uses Azure Managed Identity (set ManagedIdentityClientId for user-assigned, leave empty for system-assigned). WorkloadIdentity uses federated credentials (e.g. AKS) via the AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE environment variable. Certificate uses a certificate from a local certificate store, identified by CertificateThumbprint and CertificateStorePath.
